# Qwen3-32B rank-64 all-layer 64k TSQR QR(0) checkpoint

All 64 Value encoders are fixed to the uniform rank-64 C1 checkpoint. Every full-layer decoder is refit from 65,536 C4 rows with float32 streaming TSQR and a float64 square-root solve at `lambda=0`. Artifacts are stored in BF16.

- Checkpoint: `results/checkpoints/qwen3_32b_c1_v64_tsqr64k_qr0`

- Mean held-out relMSE: `3.228918585e+00`
- Base mean held-out relMSE: `1.414998169e-01`
- Layers improved on held-out: `0/64`
